verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is an end-to-end encrypted 2FA authenticator. A built-in assistant is unusual for this kind of app but still conceivable, so the axis applies rather than being a category error. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a built-in AI assistant or task delegation: the docs cover QR scanning, imports, backups, sharing and lock screens, and the llms.txt probe only shows docs published for external LLMs.
